title: Make a sticker from a photo
summary: Makes a sticker from a photo on the device: the subject is cut out, or the photo is cropped to a centred square. The user sees it and saves it to their own pack (ADR 0029).

phase.description: making: bipe_app_sticker_making. preview: the sticker on a checked background. failed: bipe_app_sticker_make_failed, or bipe_sticker_save_failed after a failed save.

preview.description: A local file of the made sticker, 512 by 512.

pickPhoto.effect: Opens the system photo picker for one photo. Then phase making.

save.effect: Adds the sticker to the user's pack, as sticker-import does for one file. Then bipe_sticker_saved and back to sticker-picker.

notes: On the device only. The result is 512 by 512 pixels. iOS cuts out the subject with the system vision framework and puts it on a transparent square (PNG); without a subject it crops a centred square. Android crops a centred square and encodes WebP, with no cut-out: a cut-out needs ML Kit, a Google dependency that Bipe has not decided on (a known difference between the apps). Bipe logic: StickerMaker.sticker(fromImageData:) (BipeKit StickerMaker.swift); fromPhoto in StickerImport.kt (libraries/bipe stickers).
The photo never leaves the phone; only the made sticker is uploaded, in clear, like an imported one (sticker-import).
